2015 chapter that finally killed the Heihachi–Kazuya stalemate.

How Tekken 7 connects

  • Character: Heihachi Mishima — Tekken 7 staged Heihachi's last war with Kazuya.
  • Topic: Tekken — Tekken 7 closed Heihachi's war with Kazuya.

What is Tekken 7?

Tekken 7 staged the long-delayed last fight between Heihachi and Kazuya, explained the Devil Gene's origin, and cleared the floor for Jin versus Kazuya.

Key threads lead to Heihachi Mishima and Tekken.
